entries.claim: `Config::load_from` stores the directory argument in `source` instead of the actual `verbatim.toml` file path, so `source_path()` points at the wrong object.
entries.failure_scenario: Loading a config from `<dir>/verbatim.toml` via `Config::load_from(<dir>)` will later make `credentials::resolve` and `doctor config_mode` name or chmod `<dir>` rather than `<dir>/verbatim.toml`. The refusal then targets the wrong path, and the new test that expects the file path fails.

counter_evidence.note: `let path = config_dir.join(CONFIG_FILE_NAME);` then line 616 `config.source = Some(path);` - the stored value is the verbatim.toml FILE path, not the directory argument, so source_path() names <dir>/verbatim.toml
